newsitem.title: USA: Nabors sees strong bidding activity.
newsitem.headline: Nabors sees strong bidding activity.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc, a marketer of oil well drilling and oil field services, said on Thursday that it is experiencing strong bidding activity in most of its markets.
Despite weak market conditions in California and the Rocky Mountain states, higher natural gas prices should improve conditions in this market, Nabors said.

Increases in dayrates are beginning to be experienced in primarily in Texas and Louisiana and should be increasingly apparent during the new fiscal year if the market conditions remain favorable, Nabors said.
